response.sql:
WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT
    "ordersmark",
    AVG("remaincount") AS avg_unfilled_quantity,
    COUNT(*) AS execution_count
  FROM "orderexecutions"
  WHERE "expirespot"::text BETWEEN '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533'
  GROUP BY "ordersmark"
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_unfilled_quantity) AS average_of_per_order_averages,
  SUM(execution_count) AS total_execution_count
FROM per_order;

assumptions.assumption: Per-order averages include executions with NULL remaincount values ignored by AVG; the outer average likewise ignores orders whose per-order average is NULL. COUNT(*) counts every qualifying execution, including those with NULL remaincount or ordersmark; NULL ordersmark values form one group.
